requested_outcome: Managed popular and quick-search links resolve to approved semantic pages, family and birthday event pages return relevant results, and removed homepage items never flash on refresh.
natural_destination: VII homepage and discovery rails across every supported world
authorization_boundary: Local source changes and verification only. No public deployment.

lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify canonical destinations, relevance and zero-result behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: A local fix would miss CMS overrides and sibling worlds.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test the whole family and refresh persistence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the two reported cards are fixed.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Centralize normalization and audit every managed discovery source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A family test rejects query-string destinations.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The canonical event page still has zero results.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use normalized event facets and current catalog counts.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Birthday and family facets each have current matches.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A removed homepage item still flashes.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Hydrate the homepage rail from the authoritative server presentation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: First render uses the saved presentation without default substitution.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A stale CMS link reintroduces the defect.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Normalize known legacy links and exclude unresolved query links at the shared boundary.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: CMS round-trip tests cover both cases.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the resolver and two event pages pass focused tests.

attack_questions: Does any managed default still contain a query?
Can stale CMS content bypass normalization?
Do the pages show matching results?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Rendered local homepage and event landing plus route tests.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated inventory across all supported world defaults and parser inputs.

effectiveness.baseline: Two event cards use query URLs, one returns zero results, and homepage defaults render before managed data.
effectiveness.target: Zero parameter URLs in managed defaults, nonzero event results, and no fallback flash.
